:::{#exr-cross-entropy-entropy}

#### The cross-entropy of a distribution with itself

Let $X$ have [probability mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $p = (\tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{1}{4}, \tfrac{1}{4})$ on $\set{1, 2, 3}$.
Use logarithms to base 2.

1. Compute the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $H(p, p)$.

2. Compute the [entropy](#def-entropy) $\entropyf{X}$ from its definition, and compare it with $H(p, p)$.

3. Now let $X$ have any mass function $p$ on $\set{1, \ldots, K}$.
   Show that $H(p, p) = \entropyf{X}$.

:::
